title: The shared-tree guard has a recorded ruling on path-scoped git reset, checkout and restore
why: A builder in lane guard-relative-write-escape ran `git reset -q HEAD hooks/test_guard.py` to unstage a file. No work was lost, but the rules forbid destructive git and no record says whether a path reset counts (lane report, 06:53 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: one record states whether `git reset [HEAD] -- <path>` (unstage only, no --hard, no --merge, no --keep) is allowed, and a guard test pins that verdict for both forms. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug from the lane; title by triage. Second sighting (lane findings-ride-in-lane, coordinator 07:55 CST Nov 8): a sonnet builder in its own agent worktree ran `git checkout -q -- .` to drop its own uncommitted mutant edit in merge/merge.py; no guard refused or asked. Nothing was lost, but in a shared tree it drops other agents' uncommitted work (rule shared-trees-no-destructive-git). Unlike a path reset, which only unstages, a checkout or restore of the work tree discards edits. Done check adds: `git checkout -- <paths>`, `git checkout .` and `git restore` of the work tree are refused outside the agent's own tree (or always asked), per the record. Doing in lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85), branch guard-path-reset-ruling, Merge after #1998; a test-author pins today's verdicts first (07:50 CST Nov 8). Scope includes the checkout/restore form added 07:49 CST. Notes from stack C's fresh round 3 on #2025 (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, reviewer sonnet, 04:20 CST Nov 9; #2025 60fede1fe PASS, net value zero; do after #2025 merges): (a) docs/decisions/agent-worktree-discard-is-noted.md:82, 99, 100, 103 use "deny" as the verdict word, which GLOSSARY lists under Not for refuse; reword to refuse and keep the test values `deny`. (b) The same file's "Measured" fsck claim in the unstage caveat could not be re-read (worktree isolation refused the probe). (c) hooks/guard_shared_tree.py:40 reads a staged-only change as dirty; the decision records it and test_guard.py:2918 pins it.
